summary: REQ-1009 asks for NimbusAI Contract Reviewer (Legal AI, USD 15000/year, 8 users, Finance) with confidential_documents access and a Document repository integration. Budget is sufficient (USD 29000 available, within_budget true). NimbusAI is a new vendor with no purchase history, security_status Unknown and legal_terms_status Unknown, and the vendor risk assessment service returned HTTP 503, so vendor risk could not be verified. evaluate_policy requires Department Head, Finance, Procurement, Security and Legal approvals with baseline label 'Escalate to Security for manual review'. A different vendor's approved tool (NeuralDesk Business, General AI, company-wide) may overlap with the summarization use case. No instruction-like text was found in the request. This brief only recommends; it does not approve anything.
concerns: get_vendor_risk failed with HTTP 503 (upstream vendor assessment provider temporarily unavailable); vendor risk could not be verified and no favourable status is assumed.

lookup_vendor_registry shows NimbusAI as procurement_status New, security_status Unknown, legal_terms_status Unknown, with no security_review_date; its note says the vendor assessment service may be unavailable.

The product would process confidential_documents (vendor agreements) via a Document repository integration, so Security and Legal review is required per evaluate_policy (risk_flags: vendor_risk_unavailable, security_review_required, legal_review_required).
get_purchase_history returned no purchases for NimbusAI, so there is no prior relationship or track record.

NeuralDesk Business (SW009, General AI, Approved - limited use, 150 seats, Company-wide, covers requester department) is a different vendor's catalog tool that could possibly cover contract summarization; its 'limited use' restrictions were not provided, so whether it can handle confidential documents could not be verified.
evaluate_policy lists source_code among data_classes although the request describes only vendor agreements and payment terms; this was left to the deterministic policy tool and not contradicted.

overlap_assessment.reason: find_existing_software returned NeuralDesk Business (SW009, vendor NeuralDesk, General AI, 'Approved - limited use', 150 seats, Company-wide, covers_requester_department true), a different vendor's tool that could plausibly summarize agreements and flag payment terms. The request's justification (summarize vendor agreements and flag non-standard payment terms) does not state a gap the existing tool cannot meet, so no credible gap is evidenced. The scope of the 'limited use' approval, and whether it permits confidential documents, could not be verified. CodeMate (SW008, Developer AI, Engineering only) does not cover Finance and is not a relevant match.
